infobox.usage: Unlocks the marked room on the third floor of the abandoned factory on Streets of Tarkov.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Abandoned factory marked key (Aband.) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A mysterious key to an unknown door at the abandoned city factory. There is a strange symbol scratched onto it.

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text:
- This is a required location for the quest Broadcast - Part 4
- Used in the story chapter They Are Already Here when you don't have any of the other marked keys
- Used in the story chapter The Ticket

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Marked room on the third floor of the northern abandoned factory building at Streets of Tarkov.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- 2x Weapon box (6x2)
- Loose loot (multiple very rare Valuables, Weapons, Containers, Currency, Keycards)
